top_signals.title: Bond Yields Soar, Spiking Fed Rate Hike Bets
top_signals.summary: "Bloomberg Real Yield" highlights the market-moving news you need to know. Today's guests: Parametric SMA Fixed Income Portfolio Manager Nisha Patel, Citi Head of Global Rates Deirdre Dun, Goldman Sachs Head of Multi Sector FI Investing Lindsay Sachs, Oaktree Capital Management Deputy CIO Strategic Credit Platform Milwood Hobbs. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Meta gets to consumer AI device market before OpenAI, but Zuckerberg's strategy remains unproven
top_signals.summary: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg's new Muse Charm device is intended to put his company ahead of rivals like OpenAI and Google in AI agents and consumer hardware.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: No bank too big to fail, and none too small to resolve − speech by Ruth Smith
top_signals.summary: Given at The Florence School of Banking & Finance Resolution Academy, European University Institute
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: More than $170 million in crypto moves from Bitget wallets to unidentified address
top_signals.summary: The receiving address has made several swaps, but the reason for the Bitget wallet transfers remains unclear.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
